notes.title: risk of rabbit is now available
notes.content:
hey everyone, risk of rabbit is now available to play

sorry for the delayed released, i wanted this out a month ago

i ran into some snags that needed to get resolved before release but i also decided to sneak in a couple of features i really wanted before release

i think this game is actually pretty good now, much better than what i had a month ago

if you like quick, fast paced, brainy action games, you gotta give this a go

this game doesn't have a lot of content right now, i figure most players will only get 2-4 hours of fun out of it before moving on

but i think yall will really enjoy those 2-4 hours, so think of this game as like renting a movie or something

i really like how this game turned out and plan on working on it more

its in good shape code wise and ready for new features

in the short term i plan on adding more enemys, objectives, and other incremental things

over the long term i plan on adding new classes and game modes and maybe even multiplayer?

not sure about the multiplayer quite yet, idk if it would play well for this game but who knows, i'll think about it more

i hope yall enjoy and i look forward to continuing to build a cool, little, niche, unique, action game :)
